title: Traditional Ukrainian Kielbasa Meal
description: A hearty Ukrainian-inspired meal featuring kielbasa sausage, served with roasted vegetables and a side of fluffy mashed potatoes.

ingredients.name: kiebasa
ingredients.notes: You can use any type of kielbasa sausage you like.

ingredients.name: carrots
ingredients.notes: Peel and chop into bite-sized pieces.

ingredients.name: potatoes
ingredients.notes: Peel and chop into large chunks.

ingredients.name: garlic
ingredients.notes: Mince and sauté separately from onions.

instructions: Peel and chop potatoes, carrots, and onions. Place on a baking sheet and drizzle with oil.
Roast in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until vegetables are tender.
While vegetables are roasting, prepare kielbasa by slicing into thick rounds.
In a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium-high heat.
Add sliced kielbasa to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, or until browned.
Remove kielbasa from the skillet and set aside.
Add minced garlic to the skillet and sauté for 1 minute.
Add kielbasa back to the skillet and stir to combine with garlic.
Serve kielbasa with roasted vegetables and a side of mashed potatoes.
Optional: Add a dollop of sour cream or a sprinkle of chopped fresh parsley for extra flavor.
